body:
Greg's direction (Advisor b9d13887 #702, 02:36Z, and #704, 02:38Z, 2026-10-13): a continuous implementation pipeline, preferring Codex gpt-6.1-sol coders. #704 verbatim: 'Yes: Greg's preference is explicit. After the triple gate has ended and its host record is settled, spawn fresh Codex gpt-6.1-sol worker delegations for the next disjoint prepared TermAl implementation packages. Do not spawn them during the current gate or alter its roots. Keep existing assigned owners working; report the concrete Sol sessions and claims once admitted.'
PLAN (Termal::Fable2):
- After the triple gate test-816d7435 ENDs and its typed record lands, spawn 2 Codex workers, model gpt-6.1-sol, mode worker, isolatedWorktree, from my session (never during a gate).
- Sol-1 gets w-a7bbdea31231 (the cargo target<random> sibling fence).
- Sol-2 gets w-03d466958d59 (the launcher fingerprint must not depend on line endings).
- Criteria for both are worded by me as non-completer (02:40Z).
- Existing owners: Termal::Codex (8582) has w-1bf3d434a624; CSharpProof has w-f8f8e04dffbb; Opus3 has w-66d5 (diagnosis).
Tests only in coordinator-granted filtered slots; then freeze, review pair, and offer to Termal::Merger.

02:45Z RULE (Advisor b9d13887 #706, verbatim): 'Greg confirms Codex gpt-6.1-sol is the preferred implementation model. Apply it by default to every new coder assignment. Use a different model only when Sol is unavailable or moving already-started work would cost more than continuing it; record that exception.'
RECORDED EXCEPTIONS (assigned 02:37Z, before #706):
- w-f8f8e04dffbb stays with Termal::CSharpProof (Claude): it is claimed, the plan is approved, and the Engram shapes are agreed. It wrote w-152d, so moving the work costs more.
- w-1bf3d434a624 stays with Termal::Codex (session-8582, an existing Codex root on its configured model): it is claimed, named, and its design is done.
All NEW coder assignments use Codex gpt-6.1-sol worker delegations.

02:53Z CHANGE OF ROUTE (Greg, Advisor #708: POST /api/sessions approved, with a recorded contract). Instead of child delegations, I created ROOT Codex gpt-6.1-sol sessions, workdir C:/github/Personal/TermAl, project-6, approvalPolicy never, sandboxMode danger-full-access, reasoningEffort high:
- session-12326 Termal::Sol-a7bb for w-a7bbdea31231;
- session-12327 Termal::Sol-03d4 for w-03d466958d59;
- session-12328 Termal::Sol-edfd for w-edfd8d76c6c0 (docs for this procedure).
Each receipt is recorded on its item. The Git Bash gotcha: the JSON workdir must use forward slashes.
CORRECTION: Termal::Codex (session-8582) is ALREADY gpt-6.1-sol, so it is not an exception. The only exception is CSharpProof (Claude) on w-f8f8e04dffbb.
Session-to-item map:
- 8582: w-1bf3d434a624
- 11519: w-f8f8e04dffbb
- 12326: w-a7bb
- 12327: w-03d4
- 12328: w-edfd
- Merger 11865: the triple, then w-d82e, then w-9b3a
- Opus3 9474: w-66d5 (diagnosis)

03:18Z UPDATE. Packages offered to the Merger (review-clean): w-03d4 (Sol-03d4, freeze ccc4a156, offer 01a13341, expires 04:14:30Z); w-edfd (Sol-edfd, freeze 12bcc8b1, offer 01a13340, expires 04:13:21Z); w-f8f8 (CSharpProof, offer 01a13338, expires 04:05Z). Producers re-offer at expiry. Merger order: triple re-gate, then w-d82e, w-9b3a, w-f8f8, w-edfd, w-03d4, w-a7bb. Sol-a7bb's GREEN was running at 03:13Z.
NEW ASSIGNMENT: Sol-03d4 (12327) takes w-f057e4c3a0b6 (the multi-claim carried-gate refusal that voided the triple gate; criteria proposed by Fable2 in its 03:17Z note; p1 recommended). Session map: 12327 is now w-f057. CSharpProof (11519) has no new coding package (#706), only landing support. Sol-edfd (12328) is idle after its re-offer; the S4 idle rule applies.
